name: Chibi Mall Guide v5
author: Blender 3D Gallery / agent-assisted image-to-3D reconstruction and rigging
creation_method: Reconstructed from an AI-generated reference sheet with Microsoft TRELLIS (image-to-3D), then retouched, rigged with 20 bones and given four animation clips in Blender. Not hand-modelled.
accuracy_notes: Development preview. The face is a fixed baked expression, the texture is soft, and the skinned arms and sign are crude; an independent review rated it a placeholder, not the finished character. The gallery viewer shows it at rest only; the clips (idle, walk_calm, walk_bouncy, point) were checked in Three.js but are not played by the gallery.

attribution.credit: Reconstruction with Microsoft TRELLIS (MIT-licensed code); training-data and weight terms were not reviewed.
Input reference sheet is an AI-generated concept image with uncleared rights; it is not embedded in the GLB.

rights: Rights not cleared; public redistribution terms have not been specified. Listed for viewing only, not downloadable.
